title: Build the taskgraph deterministic dependency scheduler from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the taskgraph library exactly as written in assets/gc-406/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-406/taskgraph.py. The spec demands four interlocking algorithms: Kahn ordering with lexicographic tie-breaks, parallel wave layering, a critical-path DP with a sequence-lexicographic tie-break, and cycle extraction that must report a real normalized cycle (direction and rotation both pinned) via a custom CycleError. Validation ordering (ValueError before CycleError) and bool-vs-int traps are tested. Plan the shared validation core and each algorithm, then iterate against the sealed suite until green.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-406/plan.md exists before implementation, working the spec's pipeline example through all four algorithms by hand.
workspace/gc-406/runs.log records every sealed-suite invocation with summary lines; at least one intermediate RED run before the final GREEN.
Failure identities: failing test node ids logged with the algorithm and rule (tie-break, direction, normalization, validation order) each traced to.
Recovery after RED documented as diagnosis -> fix -> re-run; the sealed test file is never modified.
